axes_source: Read from data/brands/meta.json: warmth from the hue and chroma of the primary #0064E0 and the canvas #FFFFFF; contrast from the ink #1C1E21 on that canvas, its depth and the chroma of #0064E0; density from its 4px spacing base; geometry from its radii 2, 4, 6, 8, 16, 24, 32, 40px; formality from the chroma of its primary and ink; motion at 0.5 since its motion signature states no duration; type personality at 0.5 since neither face is in the engine's catalog.
brand_rule: The primary #0064E0 reaches 5.39:1 on the canvas #FFFFFF, at least the 3:1 a control needs, so it carries the action.
name: Meta
